why: Native-incompatible durable/session checkpoints passed the shallow document check. The valid previous draft was not chosen, and asynchronous thumbnail saves could overwrite a damaged record after fallback.

baseline.secondFailure: After native validation was added, waiting for terrain completion exposed automatic overwrite of the damaged original.

fix: Native structural/version gate on current, previous and cached checkpoints; native gameplay constraints remain editable. Background/thumbnail saves preserve a record recovered from previous until a user save succeeds.
checks: Public checkpoint-fallback regression passes after real terrain completion and 650ms debounce.
Simulated hidden-document event exercises automatic background-save path.
Explicit Save writes recovered schema/title at exactly next durable revision.
Incomplete current draft and its history preserved, Test remains disabled.
Unsupported same-revision session copy cannot replace supported durable draft.
JavaScript syntax and git diff whitespace checks pass.
limits: Unsupported schema is injected data, not physical disk corruption.
Background visibility event is simulated; no operating-system power loss.
Broader crash phases, art, performance, player walkthrough and full original plan acceptance remain open.
